# netbox_owner_group (Data Source)

A NetBox owner group (users.ownergroup): a grouping of the owners objects can be assigned to.

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/users/ownergroup/):

> Groups are used to correlate and organize [owners](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/users/owner/). The assignment of an owner to a group has no bearing on the relationship of owned objects to their owners; groups exist purely as an organizational convenience for administrators.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_owner_group" "test" {
  name = "test-owner_group"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `member_count` (Number) Number of members of the group.
- `url` (String)
